facts.fact: On Adwave, Streaming TV, Google Search, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube open at a $30 daily budget.
facts.quote: Streaming TV, Google Search, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube open at $30 a day on Adwave.

facts.fact: On Adwave, Reddit opens at a $35 daily budget.
facts.quote: Reddit opens at $35, and TikTok at $91 once you turn it on in Customize and connect your TikTok account.

facts.fact: Adwave's budget ladder tops out at $10,000 per day, according to the vendor's page.
facts.quote: The ladder tops out at $10,000 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave states there is no subscription and no contract for its campaigns.
facts.quote: There is no subscription and no contract.

facts.fact: Adwave sets aside the daily amount from a prepaid wallet each morning and charges the next morning only for what ran.
facts.quote: Each morning a live campaign sets aside the daily amount from a prepaid wallet, and the next morning it is charged only for what ran.

facts.fact: Adwave charges $0.38 per image for extra creative if ordered.
facts.quote: $0.38 per image, $6 per social video, $6 per 15-second TV spot, and $12 per 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: Google Search is on from Adwave's $30 daily minimum.
facts.quote: Search is on from the $30 minimum, so a search ad can catch that query.

facts.fact: Raising the daily budget on Adwave does not change the $30 floor or turn on a channel early.
facts.quote: Raising the daily budget does not change the $30 floor, and it does not turn on a channel early.

facts.fact: TikTok is not part of the default mix at any Adwave budget and must be opted in from Customize.
facts.quote: It is not part of the default mix at any budget.
